actions: Launch a local opt-in morning bundle offer in the 15 consenting franchise stores near the Starbucks pilot cafés, featuring a $6 breakfast Meal Deal with coffee and food to reinforce value perception.
Implement targeted marketing via the Dunkin app and local channels to promote the Meal Deal and advance mobile ordering for morning peak hours (7–10 a.m. weekdays).
Monitor basket contribution, repeat visits, and labor costs closely during January 2027 to evaluate economic sustainability and customer retention.
Set a decision rule to discontinue or adjust the offer in any store where incremental economics worsen after one month.
expected_responses: Starbucks may observe competitive pressure in the morning peak and possibly adjust their pilot or marketing to maintain share.
Dutch Bros might respond with enhanced drive-through promotions or order-ahead incentives to defend their segment.
Some Dunkin franchisees may opt out if economics do not meet expectations, leading to a tailored local rollout.
answer.rationale: Given Dunkin's strength in coffee-and-food value and existing mobile ordering capabilities, launching a locally coordinated Meal Deal aligns with the incentive to win the breakfast occasion through a predictable, attractive basket. This approach leverages the brand's existing value perception and app infrastructure within the 15 franchised stores that can be controlled, while respecting the $20,000 monthly resource constraint. Monitoring economic impact ensures franchisees remain willing participants. This strategy responds to Starbucks' pilot of capacity-aware mobile pickup slots by strengthening Dunkin's competitive position in the same morning peak window without altering pricing structure nationally.
resource_commitments: Allocate up to $20,000 in January 2027 for combined local promotion and additional staffing across the 15 franchise stores.
Use existing Dunkin app infrastructure to support advance ordering and rewards integration for the Meal Deal.
Dedicate local marketing budget for digital and in-store promotion targeted at morning peak customers.
